stemMd: A digital counter shows every integer from 0 to 99 once. How many displayed numbers contain the digit 7?
explanationMd: There are ten numbers from 70 to 79 and ten ending in 7 from 7 to 97. The number 77 belongs to both groups, so total distinct numbers are 10+10−1=19.

distractorRationale.a: This counts only one position for the digit.
distractorRationale.c: This excludes 77 altogether after correcting overlap.
distractorRationale.b: This misses many numbers with seven in the units position.
